senses.en: the business of running a bank

ex.en: He works in banking in the city centre.
ex.zh: 他在市中心从事银行业。

ex.en: Online banking makes it easy to pay bills.
ex.zh: 网上银行让支付账单变得简单。

tip: banking 是银行业；online banking 是网上银行。
scene: A person using online banking on a laptop at home.

senses.en: A farm animal with a broad snout and short legs.

ex.en: A pink pig was sleeping beside the wooden fence.
ex.zh: 一头粉色的猪正睡在木栅栏旁。

ex.en: Farmers can improve animal welfare by giving pigs enough space to move freely and explore.
ex.zh: 农民可以给猪足够的自由活动和探索空间，以改善动物福利。

tip: pig指动物；作为食物的猪肉通常用pork。

senses.en: to delay something to a later time

ex.en: They put off the meeting until Friday.
ex.zh: 他们把会议推迟到周五。

ex.en: Don't put off your homework till the last minute.
ex.zh: 别把作业拖到最后一刻。

tip: put off 表示“推迟”；put off doing 是“拖延做某事”。
scene: A calendar with a meeting crossed out and moved to Friday.

senses.en: People, especially those belonging to a particular group.
Connected with the traditional culture of ordinary people.
Music rooted in the traditions of a community.

ex.en: Local folk gather here to chat every evening.
ex.zh: 当地人每晚都聚在这里聊天。

ex.en: Traditional folk music can help younger generations understand the cultural heritage of their communities.
ex.zh: 传统民间音乐能帮助年轻一代理解自己社区的文化遗产。

tip: 指人们时用复数动词；my folks口语指父母。

senses.en: making someone feel that they need rest

ex.en: Carrying these heavy bags upstairs is tiring work.
ex.zh: 把这些沉重的袋子搬上楼是件累人的活。

ex.en: Long and tiring commutes can reduce workers' productivity and leave them with less time for family activities.
ex.zh: 漫长而累人的通勤会降低员工的工作效率，也会减少他们参与家庭活动的时间。

col: a tiring journey｜令人疲惫的旅程
tip: tiring形容事物令人累；tired形容人感到累。

senses.en: a container for recycling glass bottles

ex.en: We take our old bottles to the bottle bank.
ex.zh: 我们把旧瓶子送到回收箱。

ex.en: The bottle bank is full; we'll come back later.
ex.zh: 回收箱满了，我们晚点再来。

tip: bottle bank 是街边的玻璃瓶回收点。
scene: Colourful glass bottles being dropped into a bottle recycling bin.

senses.en: a connection between people, things, or ideas
a person who belongs to your family

ex.en: The price seems to bear no relation to quality.
ex.zh: 这个价格似乎与质量毫无关系。

ex.en: Researchers are examining the relation between access to green spaces and mental health in urban communities.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在考察城市社区中绿地可及性与心理健康之间的关系。

col: relations between countries｜国家间的关系
tip: 国家或群体间的关系常用复数relations。

senses.en: to build something again after damage or destruction
to make something strong or successful again

ex.en: We plan to rebuild the garden wall this weekend.
ex.zh: 我们打算这周末重建花园围墙。

ex.en: After severe flooding, local authorities must rebuild essential infrastructure and help affected communities recover.
ex.zh: 严重洪灾过后，地方政府必须重建重要基础设施，帮助受灾社区恢复。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为 rebuilt。

senses.en: especially; more than usual

ex.en: I particularly enjoyed the music at the concert.
ex.zh: 我特别喜欢音乐会上的音乐。

ex.en: It was particularly cold this winter.
ex.zh: 今年冬天特别冷。

tip: particularly 表示“尤其、特别地”。
scene: A person smiling at a concert, enjoying the music especially.

senses.en: A group of sports teams that regularly compete against one another.
An association of people or groups sharing a common purpose.
A level of quality, ability, or achievement.

ex.en: Our team finished top of the league this season.
ex.zh: 我们队本赛季在联赛中排名第一。

ex.en: A local sports league can strengthen community ties by bringing together players from different social backgrounds.
ex.zh: 地方体育联赛可以让不同社会背景的球员聚在一起，从而加强社区联系。

col: top of the league｜联赛榜首
in a different league｜远高于一般水平
out of my league｜超出我的能力范围
tip: in a different league常指水平远胜一筹。

senses.en: the player who guards the goal

ex.en: The goalkeeper saved two important shots.
ex.zh: 守门员扑救了两次关键射门。

ex.en: He is the best goalkeeper in our school team.
ex.zh: 他是我们校队最好的守门员。

tip: goalkeeper 是守门员，口语常简称 keeper。
scene: A goalkeeper in gloves diving to save a ball in a goal.

senses.en: Not worried or excited; without strong movement or disturbance.
To become less upset, or make someone feel more relaxed.
A peaceful state without worry, noise, or disturbance.

ex.en: She stayed calm when the lights suddenly went out.
ex.zh: 灯突然熄灭时，她依然保持镇静。

ex.en: A calm classroom atmosphere can help students concentrate and feel more confident about asking questions.
ex.zh: 平静的课堂氛围有助于学生集中注意力，也让他们更有信心提问。

tip: calm中的l不发音；calm down表示平静下来。

senses.en: A person trained to put out fires and rescue people

ex.en: The firefighter showed us how to use the hose.
ex.zh: 那位消防员向我们演示了如何使用消防水带。

ex.en: Every firefighter requires regular training to respond safely and effectively to emergencies in increasingly complex urban environments.
ex.zh: 每位消防员都需要定期接受培训，以便在日益复杂的城市环境中安全、有效地应对紧急情况。

col: a trained firefighter｜训练有素的消防员
tip: firefighter不区分性别，比fireman更通用。

senses.en: A grand official home for a royal or important leader.

ex.en: We walked through the palace gardens before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前，我们在王宫花园里散了步。

ex.en: Opening a historic palace to visitors can generate income for conservation and support local tourism.
ex.zh: 向游客开放历史悠久的宫殿，可以筹集保护资金并支持当地旅游业。

tip: 主要用作名词；palace gardens中作名词定语。

senses.en: very unhappy, sometimes persistently as part of a mental illness
having little economic activity or few opportunities

ex.en: He felt depressed after weeks of unsuccessful job hunting.
ex.zh: 连续数周求职无果后，他感到很沮丧。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can connect economically depressed areas with employment opportunities and essential services.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以让经济萧条地区的居民获得就业机会和基本服务。

col: economically depressed area｜经济萧条地区
tip: depressed形容人的感受；depressing形容令人沮丧的事。

senses.en: without sleeves

ex.en: She wore a sleeveless dress in summer.
ex.zh: 夏天她穿无袖连衣裙。

ex.en: The sleeveless shirt is cool and light.
ex.zh: 这件无袖衬衫凉爽轻便。

tip: sleeveless 是“无袖的”；-less 表示“没有”。
scene: A sleeveless summer dress hanging on a hanger.

senses.en: The process of entering another country to live there.
The official checks or checkpoint for people entering a country.

ex.en: We showed our passports at immigration after the flight.
ex.zh: 下飞机后，我们在入境检查处出示了护照。

ex.en: Immigration can help address labour shortages, particularly when newcomers receive language training and employment support.
ex.zh: 移民可以帮助缓解劳动力短缺，尤其是在新移民获得语言培训和就业支持的情况下。

col: go through immigration｜接受入境检查
tip: immigration强调迁入；emigration强调迁出。

senses.en: An aircraft powered by jet engines.
A narrow, forceful stream of liquid or gas.

ex.en: A jet flew low over the beach this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上一架喷气式飞机低空飞过海滩。

ex.en: Replacing older passenger jets with more efficient aircraft could reduce fuel consumption across the aviation industry.
ex.zh: 用效率更高的飞机替换老旧客机，可以降低整个航空业的燃料消耗。

col: a jet of water｜一股喷射的水流
tip: a jet of water指一股喷射的水流。

senses.en: an accident in which a vehicle hits something or falls
to hit something violently or fall and be badly damaged
to stop working suddenly or lose value very quickly

ex.en: Nobody was hurt in the crash outside our house.
ex.zh: 我们家外面的那起撞车事故没有造成人员受伤。

ex.en: Financial markets can crash when investors suddenly lose confidence in the stability of the economy.
ex.zh: 当投资者突然对经济的稳定性失去信心时，金融市场可能暴跌。

col: a stock market crash｜股市崩盘
tip: crash into后接撞上的物体；电脑崩溃也可用crash。

senses.en: a long narrow line of colour

ex.en: The T-shirt has blue and white stripes.
ex.zh: 这件T恤有蓝白条纹。

ex.en: A zebra has black and white stripes.
ex.zh: 斑马有黑白条纹。

tip: stripe 是条纹；striped 是“有条纹的”。
scene: A blue and white striped T-shirt on a hanger.

senses.en: To want something or feel like doing something.
Decorative, elaborate, or expensive rather than plain.
To feel romantically attracted to someone.

ex.en: Do you fancy a walk by the river after lunch?
ex.zh: 午饭后你想去河边散步吗？

ex.en: Some tourists prefer simple local accommodation to fancy hotels because it offers more opportunities for cultural exchange.
ex.zh: 一些游客更喜欢简朴的当地住宿，而非豪华酒店，因为前者提供更多文化交流机会。

col: a fancy restaurant｜一家豪华餐厅
tip: 表示“想做”时用fancy doing，不用fancy to do。

senses.en: a useful piece of advice
the narrow or pointed end of something
extra money given to someone for providing a service

ex.en: My neighbour shared a useful tip for growing tomatoes.
ex.zh: 邻居分享了一个种番茄的实用窍门。

ex.en: Schools can offer practical tips on managing money to help young people develop responsible spending habits.
ex.zh: 学校可以提供实用的理财建议，帮助年轻人养成负责任的消费习惯。

col: the tip of the tongue｜舌尖
tip: tip作“建议”可数，advice不可数：a tip。

senses.en: A person kept in prison or prevented from leaving.
A person captured and held by an enemy during war.

ex.en: The prisoner borrowed a novel from the prison library.
ex.zh: 那名囚犯从监狱图书馆借了一本小说。

ex.en: Providing prisoners with education and vocational training may improve their chances of finding employment after release.
ex.zh: 为囚犯提供教育和职业培训，可能提高他们获释后找到工作的机会。

tip: prisoner 不一定已被定罪，也可指被俘或被拘禁者。

senses.en: Required to be paid or submitted by a particular time.
Expected to happen or arrive at a particular time.
Deserved or appropriate in a particular situation.

ex.en: Our rent is due at the end of the week.
ex.zh: 我们的房租本周末到期应付。

ex.en: When tuition fees are due, some students struggle to cover both educational expenses and basic living costs.
ex.zh: 学费到期应缴时，一些学生难以同时承担教育支出和基本生活费用。

tip: be due to do表示预计做；due to＋名词表示由于。

senses.en: a person trained to travel and work in space

ex.en: The astronaut floated gently through the small space station.
ex.zh: 那名宇航员轻轻地飘过小型空间站。

ex.en: Astronauts conduct experiments in space that help scientists understand how the human body responds to weightlessness.
ex.zh: 宇航员在太空中开展实验，帮助科学家了解人体对失重的反应。

col: a team of astronauts｜一队宇航员
tip: astronaut是宇航员；astronomer是天文学家。

senses.en: be or move into positions on every side of something
be closely connected with an event, situation, or subject

ex.en: Tall trees surround the cottage and shade its windows.
ex.zh: 高大的树木环绕着小屋，为窗户遮阴。

ex.en: Uncertainty continues to surround the proposed transport scheme, making it difficult for local businesses to plan ahead.
ex.zh: 拟议中的交通方案仍存在不确定性，使当地企业难以提前规划。

col: surround yourself with｜使自己身边充满
the circumstances surrounding｜与……有关的情况
tip: 常用be surrounded by；surroundings指周围环境。

senses.en: A set of connected parts that work together.
An organised structure through which services or institutions operate.
An organised way of doing something.

ex.en: The heating system stopped working during a cold night.
ex.zh: 在一个寒冷的夜晚，供暖系统停止了运行。

ex.en: An effective education system should support students with different abilities and prepare them for future employment.
ex.zh: 有效的教育体系应支持能力各异的学生，并帮助他们为未来就业做好准备。

col: public transport system｜公共交通系统
tip: systematic指有条理的，systemic指全系统的。

senses.en: The direction between north and east, or an area's northeastern part.
Located in, facing, or coming from the northeast.
Towards or in the direction between north and east.

ex.en: The storm is moving northeast towards the coastal villages.
ex.zh: 暴风雨正向东北方向的沿海村庄移动。

ex.en: Investment in rail connections could improve access to employment for communities in the northeast of the country.
ex.zh: 投资铁路交通可以为该国东北部的社区居民提供更多就业便利。

tip: northeast of表示在……东北方；英式也写north-east。

senses.en: A person from a country other than the one being discussed.

ex.en: As a foreigner, I needed help understanding local customs.
ex.zh: 作为外国人，我需要别人帮助我了解当地习俗。

ex.en: Language courses can help foreigners participate more fully in community life and access essential public services.
ex.zh: 语言课程可以帮助外国人更充分地参与社区生活，并获得必要的公共服务。

col: foreigners living abroad｜在海外生活的外国人
tip: 泛指外国人；特指游客时用visitor更自然。

senses.en: Having formally agreed to marry someone.
Actively involved in an activity or task.
Currently being used and therefore unavailable.

ex.en: My sister got engaged during her holiday by the sea.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在海边度假时订婚了。

ex.en: Students who are actively engaged in classroom discussions often develop stronger communication and critical thinking skills.
ex.zh: 积极参与课堂讨论的学生往往能培养更强的沟通和批判性思维能力。

col: the line is engaged｜电话占线
tip: 订婚对象前用to；参与的活动前用in。

senses.en: someone who behaves without good sense or judgment
to make someone believe something that is not true

ex.en: The realistic plastic spider fooled everyone at the party.
ex.zh: 那只逼真的塑料蜘蛛骗过了聚会上的所有人。

ex.en: Misleading advertisements can fool consumers into buying products that offer little practical benefit.
ex.zh: 误导性广告可能诱使消费者购买几乎没有实际用处的产品。

col: fool someone into doing something｜骗某人做某事
make a fool of yourself｜出洋相
tip: fool作名词称呼别人有贬义；动词可接into doing。

senses.en: The rules for combining words and changing their forms.

ex.en: Our teacher explains grammar using examples from everyday conversations.
ex.zh: 我们的老师用日常对话中的例子讲解语法。

ex.en: Although grammar instruction is important, language courses should also give learners opportunities to communicate in realistic situations.
ex.zh: 虽然语法教学很重要，语言课程也应让学习者有机会在真实情境中交流。

tip: 表示语法知识时不可数；一个语法错误用a grammar mistake。

senses.en: as many as; until; depending on

ex.en: The bus can carry up to fifty passengers.
ex.zh: 这辆公交车最多可载五十名乘客。

ex.en: It's up to you to decide.
ex.zh: 由你决定。

tip: up to 表示“多达/直到”；be up to sb 是“由某人决定”。
scene: A full bus with a sign showing passenger capacity.

senses.en: Two people who are married or in a romantic relationship.
Two things or people, or a small number of them.
To join two things or consider them together.

ex.en: The couple next door invited us over for dinner.
ex.zh: 隔壁那对夫妇邀请我们去吃晚饭。

ex.en: High housing costs, coupled with limited childcare, can discourage young couples from starting a family.
ex.zh: 高昂的住房成本加上有限的托育服务，可能使年轻夫妇不愿生育孩子。

col: a married couple｜一对已婚夫妇
tip: a couple of后接复数名词，可指两个或少数几个。

senses.en: the hours when a shop or office is open

ex.en: The museum's opening hours are ten to five.
ex.zh: 博物馆的营业时间是十点到五点。

ex.en: Check the opening hours before you visit.
ex.zh: 参观前请查看营业时间。

tip: opening hours 是营业/开放时间。
scene: A sign on a shop door showing the opening hours.

senses.en: Permission to enter a place or join an institution
The money paid to enter a place
A statement accepting that something is true, often something unpleasant

ex.en: Admission to the museum is free on Sundays.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆周日免费开放。

ex.en: University admission should reflect academic potential rather than simply rewarding access to expensive private education.
ex.zh: 大学录取应看重学术潜力，而非仅仅让能接受昂贵私立教育的人获益。

tip: 进入某处用admission to；承认某事用admission of。

senses.en: To move someone or something from one place to another.
To change to another vehicle, school, or institution.
The act of moving something or someone to another place.

ex.en: Please transfer the photos from your camera to my laptop.
ex.zh: 请把相机里的照片传到我的笔记本电脑上。

ex.en: Governments should support the transfer of clean technology to regions that still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 政府应支持向仍高度依赖化石燃料的地区转移清洁技术。

tip: 名词重音在首音节；过去式transferred双写r。

senses.en: connected with love or expressing loving feelings
seeing things as more beautiful or exciting than they really are
someone strongly influenced by love, imagination, or idealistic hopes

ex.en: They enjoyed a romantic dinner beside the quiet lake.
ex.zh: 他们在宁静的湖边享用了一顿浪漫的晚餐。

ex.en: Advertisements often present a romantic image of rural life while ignoring limited services and employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 广告常把乡村生活描绘得很美好，却忽视了服务和就业机会不足的问题。

col: a romantic view of｜对……的理想化看法
tip: 除爱情义外，也可指把现实想得过于美好。

senses.en: a small, flat piece of metal used as money
to invent a new word or expression

ex.en: A silver coin rolled under the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 一枚银色硬币滚到了厨房桌子下面。

ex.en: As digital payments become more widespread, fewer consumers carry coins for everyday purchases such as bus fares.
ex.zh: 随着数字支付日益普及，随身携带硬币用于公交车费等日常支出的人越来越少。

tip: coin作动词常指创造词语，如coin a term。

senses.en: on fire; very hot

ex.en: The burning building sent smoke into the sky.
ex.zh: 燃烧的大楼冒出浓烟。

ex.en: She had a burning fever and stayed in bed.
ex.zh: 她发高烧，卧床休息。

tip: burning 是形容词“燃烧的、滚烫的”。
scene: A small fire burning in a garden fire pit with logs.

senses.en: an ability to do something well, developed through practice

ex.en: Baking good bread takes patience and a little skill.
ex.zh: 烤出好面包需要耐心和一点技巧。

ex.en: Schools should teach practical skills that help young people manage money and communicate effectively.
ex.zh: 学校应教授实用技能，帮助年轻人管理金钱并进行有效沟通。

col: develop a skill｜培养一项技能
skill in doing something｜做某事的技巧
tip: 具体技能可数；泛指熟练程度时常不可数。

senses.en: No longer worried because something unpleasant has ended or been avoided

ex.en: I felt relieved when I finally found my keys.
ex.zh: 终于找到钥匙时，我松了一口气。

ex.en: Residents were relieved to hear that the local hospital would remain open despite proposed budget cuts.
ex.zh: 尽管有人提议削减预算，居民听说当地医院仍将继续运营，都松了一口气。

col: relieved to hear｜听到后感到放心
tip: 常用be relieved to do或be relieved that从句。

senses.en: to use all of something and have none left

ex.en: We ran out of milk, so I went to the shop.
ex.zh: 牛奶喝完了，所以我去商店。

ex.en: Time is running out for the exam.
ex.zh: 考试时间快用完了。

tip: run out of + 名词 表示“用完某物”。
scene: An empty milk carton in a fridge.

senses.en: At a time before now or before another event.

ex.en: I had previously met our neighbour at the library.
ex.zh: 我先前在图书馆见过我们的邻居。

ex.en: Online courses now provide educational opportunities for people who previously had limited access to universities.
ex.zh: 在线课程如今为那些以前难以接受大学教育的人提供了学习机会。

tip: previously意为先前；表示提前准备通常用in advance。

senses.en: to look for something carefully

ex.en: I searched online for a cheap hotel.
ex.zh: 我在网上搜索便宜的酒店。

ex.en: The search for the missing cat continued all day.
ex.zh: 寻找失踪猫咪的行动持续了一整天。

tip: search for 是“搜索寻找”；search engine 是搜索引擎。
scene: A person typing a search query into a laptop.

senses.en: Something said or done to make people laugh.
To say something funny or not seriously meant.

ex.en: My brother told a joke that made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 我哥哥讲了个笑话，把大家都逗笑了。

ex.en: Teachers sometimes use jokes to reduce anxiety and create a more relaxed classroom atmosphere.
ex.zh: 教师有时会用笑话缓解焦虑，营造更轻松的课堂氛围。

col: play a joke on someone｜捉弄某人
joke about something｜拿某事开玩笑
tip: 讲笑话用tell a joke，不用say a joke。

senses.en: happening or existing before the time or thing being discussed

ex.en: The previous tenant left some plants on the balcony.
ex.zh: 上一位租客在阳台上留下了几盆植物。

ex.en: Previous studies suggest that regular physical activity can improve concentration and academic performance among school children.
ex.zh: 先前的研究表明，经常运动能提高学龄儿童的专注力和学习成绩。

tip: previous是形容词；表示“以前”用副词previously。

senses.en: A person who does not eat meat or fish.
Containing no meat or fish, or following this diet.

ex.en: My sister became a vegetarian after learning to cook.
ex.zh: 我姐姐学会做饭后成了一名素食者。

ex.en: Providing vegetarian meals in school canteens can accommodate different dietary preferences and reduce environmental impacts.
ex.zh: 学校食堂提供素食可以满足不同的饮食偏好，并减少对环境的影响。

tip: vegetarian不吃肉和鱼；vegan还不吃蛋奶等动物产品。

senses.en: most important among several things
the person in charge of a school or college
money borrowed or invested, excluding interest

ex.en: Our principal reason for moving was the noisy traffic.
ex.zh: 我们搬家的主要原因是交通噪声太大。

ex.en: The principal challenge facing urban planners is providing affordable housing without reducing access to green spaces.
ex.zh: 城市规划者面临的主要挑战是提供经济适用的住房，同时不减少居民享用绿地的机会。

tip: principal指“主要的”或“校长”；principle指“原则”。

senses.en: a machine that washes dishes and kitchen utensils
a person employed to wash dishes

ex.en: Please load the dishwasher after you finish your lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭吃完后，请把餐具放进洗碗机。

ex.en: Running a dishwasher only when it is full can help households conserve water and energy.
ex.zh: 等洗碗机装满后再运行，有助于家庭节约水和能源。

col: load the dishwasher｜把餐具装进洗碗机
unload the dishwasher｜取出洗碗机里的餐具
dishwasher detergent｜洗碗机专用洗涤剂
tip: 日常多指洗碗机；招聘语境中也可指洗碗工。

senses.en: to welcome someone or say hello
to become noticeable when someone arrives or looks

ex.en: Our neighbours greeted us warmly when we moved in.
ex.zh: 我们搬来时，邻居们热情地向我们打招呼。

ex.en: Visitors are greeted by trained volunteers who explain the museum's collection and help them find their way.
ex.zh: 受过培训的志愿者迎接参观者，介绍博物馆的藏品并为他们指路。

col: greet someone warmly｜热情地问候某人
greet someone with a smile｜微笑着迎接某人
be greeted by｜受到迎接；首先看到
tip: greet直接接人；表示向某人问好不加to。

senses.en: A small booklet giving information about products, services, or places.

ex.en: I picked up a travel brochure at the station.
ex.zh: 我在车站拿了一本旅游宣传册。

ex.en: University brochures can help prospective students compare courses, accommodation options, and the facilities available on campus.
ex.zh: 大学宣传册可以帮助有意申请的学生比较课程、住宿选择及校园设施。

tip: 可数名词，常指介绍旅游、课程或产品的小册子。

senses.en: In every way or to the fullest possible degree.

ex.en: My shoes were completely wet after walking through the rain.
ex.zh: 在雨中走过之后，我的鞋全湿透了。

ex.en: Although online courses offer flexibility, they cannot completely replace the social benefits of classroom learning.
ex.zh: 虽然在线课程提供了灵活性，但它们无法完全取代课堂学习带来的社交益处。

tip: 表示程度达到全部，常修饰形容词或动词。

senses.en: The part of a garment that covers an arm.
A protective cover that fits closely around an object.

ex.en: I caught my sleeve on the kitchen door handle.
ex.zh: 我的袖子被厨房门把手勾住了。

ex.en: Workers should keep loose sleeves away from moving machinery to reduce the risk of workplace injuries.
ex.zh: 工人应让宽松的袖子远离运转中的机器，以降低工伤风险。

col: roll up your sleeves｜卷起袖子
tip: sleeve指衣服的袖子，不是手臂arm。

senses.en: A sound, movement, or light that communicates a message.
An electrical or radio wave carrying information.
Communicate through an action, or indicate that something is happening.

ex.en: The coach gave a signal, and we started running.
ex.zh: 教练发出信号后，我们开始跑步。

ex.en: Increasing investment in renewable energy may signal a government's commitment to reducing its dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 增加可再生能源投资，可能表明政府致力于减少对化石燃料的依赖。

tip: 过去式英式常写signalled，美式常写signaled。

senses.en: Thick, stiff paper used for boxes and packaging

ex.en: We cut the cardboard into shapes for a model house.
ex.zh: 我们把硬纸板剪成各种形状，用来制作房屋模型。

ex.en: Replacing plastic packaging with recycled cardboard can reduce waste and encourage more sustainable consumption.
ex.zh: 用再生硬纸板替代塑料包装可以减少废弃物，并促进更可持续的消费。

col: a sheet of cardboard｜一张硬纸板
tip: 通常不可数；一张硬纸板说a sheet of cardboard。

senses.en: having a duty to manage or look after something
being the cause of something, especially something bad
sensible and trustworthy in your actions and decisions

ex.en: I'm responsible for feeding our cat every morning.
ex.zh: 我负责每天早晨喂我们家的猫。

ex.en: Governments are responsible for ensuring that all children have access to safe and affordable education.
ex.zh: 政府有责任确保所有儿童都能接受安全且负担得起的教育。

col: hold someone responsible｜认定某人应担责
tip: responsible for后接名词或动名词；to后接上级。

senses.en: using circuits to control electrical signals
stored, sent, or accessed using computers

ex.en: Please switch off your electronic devices during the performance.
ex.zh: 演出期间请关闭电子设备。

ex.en: Electronic health records can help doctors share information efficiently, but strong safeguards are needed to protect patient privacy.
ex.zh: 电子健康档案能帮助医生高效共享信息，但必须采取有力措施保护患者隐私。

tip: electronic强调电子电路；electric泛指用电的。

senses.en: something that happens because of an action or event
the final score or outcome of a test or competition
to happen because of something or cause something to happen

ex.en: The shiny floor was the result of hours of cleaning.
ex.zh: 这光亮的地板是花了好几个小时打扫的成果。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can result in lower emissions and shorter commuting times for urban residents.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通，可以减少排放并缩短城市居民的通勤时间。

tip: result in后接结果；result from后接原因。

senses.en: a speech sound involving blocked airflow, or its written symbol
agreeing with or matching something

ex.en: Try saying the final consonant slowly and clearly.
ex.zh: 试着把最后一个辅音发得缓慢而清晰。

ex.en: Learners may struggle to pronounce consonant clusters that do not occur in their first language.
ex.zh: 学习者可能难以发出母语中不存在的辅音群。

tip: 作形容词较正式，常用consonant with表示相符。

senses.en: used to talk about the future

ex.en: I will call you tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天会给你打电话。

ex.en: Will you come to my party on Saturday?
ex.zh: 你周六会来参加我的聚会吗？

tip: will + 动词原形表示将来；口语缩写 'll。
scene: A person talking on the phone, promising to call tomorrow.

senses.en: something you do regularly, often without thinking

ex.en: Checking my phone before breakfast has become a habit.
ex.zh: 早餐前查看手机已经成了我的习惯。

ex.en: Developing the habit of regular exercise during childhood can improve health throughout adult life.
ex.zh: 在童年时期养成规律锻炼的习惯，可以改善整个成年阶段的健康状况。

col: get into the habit of｜养成……的习惯
tip: 表示做某事的习惯，用habit of doing。

senses.en: Close to a particular amount, but not exactly.

ex.en: The walk to the lake takes approximately twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 步行到湖边大约需要二十分钟。

ex.en: Approximately half of the households surveyed reported using public transport at least once a week.
ex.zh: 受访家庭中，约有一半表示每周至少使用一次公共交通。

tip: 多放在数量前，语气比about更正式。

senses.en: To mark an item as correct, or make repeated clicking sounds.
A mark showing correctness, or a short sound a clock makes.
A small creature that attaches to skin and feeds on blood.

ex.en: The old clock ticks softly beside my bed.
ex.zh: 那只旧钟在我的床边轻轻地滴答作响。

ex.en: Participants should tick the appropriate boxes to indicate how frequently they use public transport.
ex.zh: 参与者应在相应方框内打钩，说明自己使用公共交通的频率。

col: tick a box｜在方框内打钩
a clock ticks｜钟表滴答作响
tip: “打钩”英式常用tick，美式常用check。

senses.en: the dot at the end of a sentence (British English)

ex.en: Write a full stop at the end of each sentence.
ex.zh: 每个句子结尾要写句号。

ex.en: In the US, a full stop is called a period.
ex.zh: 在美国，句号叫 period。

tip: full stop 是英式说法；美式说 period。
scene: A sentence on a blackboard ending with a red full stop.

senses.en: Something said or done to alert someone to danger or problems.
A sign that something harmful or unpleasant may happen.

ex.en: We turned back after the guide's warning about slippery rocks.
ex.zh: 听到向导提醒岩石湿滑后，我们折返了。

ex.en: Effective flood warning systems allow residents to leave dangerous areas before roads become impossible to use.
ex.zh: 有效的洪水预警系统能让居民在道路无法通行前撤离危险区域。

tip: warning是名词，也可作warn的现在分词。

senses.en: a place where you buy tickets

ex.en: We bought our train tickets at the booking office.
ex.zh: 我们在售票处买了火车票。

ex.en: The booking office opens at nine in the morning.
ex.zh: 售票处早上九点开门。

tip: booking office 即售票处，常见于火车站、剧院。
scene: A train station booking office window with tickets being handed over.

senses.zh: 旅行社职员；旅行代理人
senses.en: a person who helps you book holidays

ex.en: The travel agent booked our flights and hotel.
ex.zh: 旅行社职员帮我们订了机票和酒店。

ex.en: Ask the travel agent about cheap packages.
ex.zh: 问问旅行社职员有哪些便宜套餐。

tip: travel agent 是旅行代理；travel agency 是旅行社。
scene: A travel agent showing holiday brochures to a customer.

senses.en: something made or grown to be sold or used
something that results from a process or situation
the result of multiplying two or more quantities

ex.en: This cleaning product removes stains from my kitchen tiles.
ex.zh: 这款清洁产品能去除我家厨房瓷砖上的污渍。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly prefer products that use less packaging and can be repaired rather than replaced.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越偏好包装更少、能够维修而不必更换的产品。

tip: product是产品或结果，production是生产过程。

senses.en: An effort to do something, especially something difficult.
To try to do something, especially something difficult.

ex.en: My first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly successful.
ex.zh: 我第一次尝试烤面包，结果出乎意料地成功。

ex.en: Many cities are attempting to reduce air pollution by improving public transport and expanding cycling networks.
ex.zh: 许多城市正通过改善公共交通和扩展自行车道网络来尝试减少空气污染。

col: attempt to do something｜尝试做某事
in an attempt to｜为了尝试
tip: 动词后接to do；名词常用an attempt at doing。

senses.en: the act of taking goods or messages to someone
the process of giving birth to a baby
the way someone speaks or performs in public

ex.en: Our grocery delivery arrived just before we started cooking.
ex.zh: 我们订购的食品杂货在开始做饭前刚好送到了。

ex.en: The growing demand for home delivery has increased traffic congestion in many urban neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 不断增长的送货上门需求加剧了许多城市社区的交通拥堵。

tip: delivery指递送服务或过程；deliver是动词。

senses.en: used to introduce your own opinion or preference
by a particular person rather than someone acting for them
as relating to someone's character rather than their actions

ex.en: Personally, I prefer walking to taking the bus.
ex.zh: 就我个人而言，我更喜欢步行而不是乘公交车。

ex.en: Personally, I believe that public libraries remain essential because they provide free access to reliable information.
ex.zh: 我个人认为，公共图书馆仍不可或缺，因为它们让人们免费获取可靠信息。

col: take something personally｜认为某事针对自己
know someone personally｜与某人本人相识
tip: take it personally指把事情看作针对自己。

senses.en: the passage inside the neck through which air and food pass

ex.en: My throat felt dry after talking all afternoon.
ex.zh: 说了一下午话后，我觉得喉咙很干。

ex.en: Poor air quality can irritate the throat and worsen breathing problems, particularly among children and older adults.
ex.zh: 空气质量差会刺激咽喉并加重呼吸问题，儿童和老年人尤其容易受到影响。

tip: 喉咙痛用have a sore throat，注意冠词a。

senses.en: believing in your own ability to succeed
certain that something is true or will happen

ex.en: After weeks of practice, I felt confident on stage.
ex.zh: 经过几周练习，我站在台上时感到很自信。

ex.en: Students become more confident when teachers provide constructive feedback and opportunities to practise new skills.
ex.zh: 当教师提供建设性反馈和练习新技能的机会时，学生会变得更自信。

col: confident about the future｜对未来有信心
tip: confident是形容词；confidence是名词。

senses.en: one part of a television or radio series
a particular event or period within a longer story
a period when someone experiences a particular illness or symptom

ex.en: We watched the final episode together after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们一起看了最后一集。

ex.en: Each episode of the documentary explores how urban development affects wildlife in different parts of the world.
ex.zh: 这部纪录片每一集都探讨城市发展如何影响世界不同地区的野生动物。

col: a brief episode｜一段短暂经历
tip: episode指一集；series指整部系列或连续剧。

senses.en: to choose or try something

ex.en: I'll go for the salad, please.
ex.zh: 我要沙拉。

ex.en: She decided to go for the job interview.
ex.zh: 她决定去参加求职面试。

tip: go for 表示“选择、尝试”，也表“去拿”。
scene: A person choosing a salad at a food counter.

senses.en: a device that slows or stops a moving vehicle
to slow or stop a vehicle using its brakes

ex.en: I squeezed the brakes as my bicycle reached the corner.
ex.zh: 自行车骑到拐角时，我捏紧了刹车。

ex.en: Drivers should brake gently on wet roads to reduce the risk of losing control.
ex.zh: 驾驶员在湿滑路面上应轻踩刹车，以降低车辆失控的风险。

tip: brake指刹车；同音词break指打破或休息。

senses.en: a structure that surrounds or supports something
to put a picture or similar object inside a frame
to express or present something in a particular way

ex.en: We chose a wooden frame for our family photograph.
ex.zh: 我们为全家福选了一个木制相框。

ex.en: The way journalists frame environmental issues can influence public attitudes towards conservation and government policy.
ex.zh: 记者呈现环境议题的方式会影响公众对环境保护和政府政策的态度。

col: frame a question｜组织问题的措辞
a frame of reference｜参照体系
tip: frame既可指实体框架，也可指组织表达的方式。

senses.en: a device that heats air, water, or another substance

ex.en: We switched on the heater before the guests arrived.
ex.zh: 客人到来前，我们打开了取暖器。

ex.en: Replacing an inefficient water heater can lower household energy bills and reduce overall electricity consumption.
ex.zh: 更换效率低下的热水器能降低家庭能源账单，并减少总体用电量。

tip: heater是设备；heating指供暖或供暖系统。

senses.en: Someone qualified to advise people about law and represent them.

ex.en: Our lawyer explained the contract before we signed it.
ex.zh: 我们的律师在我们签字前解释了合同内容。

ex.en: Access to an affordable lawyer helps ensure that everyone can defend their legal rights.
ex.zh: 能以可负担的费用聘请律师，有助于确保每个人都能维护自己的合法权利。

tip: lawyer是律师的统称，区别于法官judge。

senses.en: The natural features of a place considered for their beauty.
Painted backgrounds and structures that create a play's setting.

ex.en: We stopped by the lake to admire the scenery.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边停下来欣赏风景。

ex.en: Protecting natural scenery can attract responsible tourism while preserving valuable habitats for local wildlife.
ex.zh: 保护自然风景可以吸引负责任的旅游活动，同时为当地野生动物保留宝贵的栖息地。

tip: scenery是不可数名词，不说a scenery或sceneries。

senses.en: A single object, especially one in a collection.
One part of a list, programme, or news report.

ex.en: Please place each item carefully in the shopping bag.
ex.zh: 请把每件商品小心地放进购物袋。

ex.en: Each item on the meeting agenda addresses a different challenge facing local public transport services.
ex.zh: 会议议程中的每一项都涉及当地公共交通服务面临的不同挑战。

tip: item是可数名词；一件衣物可说an item of clothing。

senses.en: the joint where your arm bends
to push someone or something with your elbow

ex.en: I knocked my elbow against the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 我的胳膊肘撞到了厨房门上。

ex.en: Passengers sometimes elbow their way onto crowded trains, making public transport uncomfortable for others.
ex.zh: 乘客有时用肘推挤着登上拥挤的列车，让其他人乘车时感到不适。

col: rest your elbows on｜将双肘搁在……上
elbow your way through｜用肘推挤着穿过
tip: elbow作动词时常指用肘推挤着前进。

senses.en: located in a particular place
in a particular set of circumstances

ex.en: Our hotel is situated beside a quiet mountain lake.
ex.zh: 我们的酒店坐落在一处宁静的高山湖泊旁。

ex.en: Schools situated near busy roads may need additional measures to protect pupils from air pollution.
ex.zh: 位于繁忙道路附近的学校可能需要采取额外措施，保护学生免受空气污染的影响。

tip: 常用be situated in/near，描述位置，较正式。

senses.en: Despite the fact that something is true.
Used to introduce a contrasting point, often at sentence end.

ex.en: Though it was raining, we still walked to the bakery.
ex.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是步行去了面包店。

ex.en: Though online courses offer greater flexibility, many students still benefit from direct interaction with teachers.
ex.zh: 虽然线上课程更加灵活，但许多学生仍能从与教师的直接交流中获益。

tip: 引导让步从句时不与but连用；句末可表“不过”。

senses.en: Involving people physically present together and looking at each other.
With people physically present together rather than communicating remotely.

ex.en: We arranged a face-to-face meeting at the local café.
ex.zh: 我们安排在附近的咖啡馆当面会谈。

ex.en: Face-to-face communication can strengthen relationships between teachers and students by allowing immediate feedback and clearer emotional expression.
ex.zh: 面对面交流能提供即时反馈并更清晰地表达情感，从而增进师生关系。

tip: 名词前通常加连字符；作状语时常写face to face。

senses.en: if; used to express a choice

ex.en: I don't know whether she will come.
ex.zh: 我不知道她是否会来。

ex.en: Ask whether the shop is open on Sundays.
ex.zh: 问问商店周日是否开门。

tip: whether 与 if 都可表“是否”；whether 后可直接接 or not。
scene: A person on the phone asking whether a shop is open.

senses.en: powder made by grinding grain, used especially in baking
to cover a surface or food lightly with flour

ex.en: Add the flour slowly and stir until smooth.
ex.zh: 慢慢加入面粉，搅拌至顺滑。

ex.en: Replacing some refined flour with wholemeal flour can increase the fibre content of everyday foods.
ex.zh: 用全麦面粉替代部分精制面粉，可以提高日常食品中的膳食纤维含量。

col: flour a surface｜在台面上撒面粉
tip: flour通常不可数，且与flower同音。

senses.en: The act of leaving a vehicle in a particular place.
Space or facilities where vehicles can be left.

ex.en: Parking is difficult on this narrow street after sunset.
ex.zh: 日落后，在这条狭窄的街道上停车很困难。

ex.en: Reducing free parking in city centres may encourage commuters to use public transport more frequently.
ex.zh: 减少市中心的免费停车位可能促使通勤者更频繁地使用公共交通。

tip: 名词通常不可数；一个停车位说a parking space。

senses.en: To take something's place or put something else in its place.
To put something back where it was before.

ex.en: We need to replace the broken kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 我们需要换掉厨房里那把坏椅子。

ex.en: Renewable energy could gradually replace fossil fuels if governments invest sufficiently in infrastructure and storage technology.
ex.zh: 如果政府充分投资基础设施和储能技术，可再生能源就可能逐步取代化石燃料。

tip: replace A with B是用B换掉A，别弄反方向。

senses.en: someone who entertains an audience by acting, singing, or playing

senses.zh: 表现出某种水平的人或事物
senses.en: a person or thing achieving a particular level of success

ex.en: A street performer juggled oranges beside the crowded market.
ex.zh: 一名街头艺人在拥挤的市场旁抛接橙子。

ex.en: Public funding can help young performers develop their skills and bring live entertainment to underserved communities.
ex.zh: 公共资金可以帮助年轻表演者提升技能，并将现场演出带到文化服务不足的社区。

tip: 不仅指演员；top performer也可指业绩优异的员工。

senses.en: An outdoor area beside a building, often enclosed.
A unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 metres.

ex.en: Our dog chased a yellow ball across the yard.
ex.zh: 我们的狗追着一个黄色的球跑过院子。

ex.en: Converting an unused school yard into a garden can provide valuable outdoor learning opportunities for urban children.
ex.zh: 把闲置的校园庭院改成花园，可以为城市儿童提供宝贵的户外学习机会。

col: a yard of fabric｜一码布料
tip: 美式yard可指住宅草坪庭院；英式多用garden。

senses.en: Earth's solid surface, or an area used for a particular purpose.
To reach the ground, or bring an aircraft to the ground.
To succeed in getting something desirable, especially a job.

ex.en: After hours at sea, we finally spotted dry land.
ex.zh: 在海上航行数小时后，我们终于看到了陆地。

ex.en: Protecting agricultural land from urban expansion is essential for maintaining food production near growing cities.
ex.zh: 保护农业用地免受城市扩张侵占，对维持发展中城市周边的粮食生产至关重要。

col: land a job｜成功找到工作
tip: 表示土地通常不可数；land a job指成功获得工作。

senses.en: Worried or nervous about something uncertain.
Very eager to do something or for something to happen.

ex.en: I felt anxious while waiting for my exam results.
ex.zh: 等待考试成绩时，我感到很焦虑。

ex.en: Students may become anxious about their future when career guidance is unavailable at school.
ex.zh: 学校不提供职业指导时，学生可能会对未来感到焦虑。

tip: anxious about表担忧；anxious to do常表急切。

senses.en: To give out or reflect light.
To polish something until its surface becomes bright and smooth.
Brightness on a smooth surface that reflects light.

ex.en: The sun shone through my bedroom window this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，阳光透过我卧室的窗户照了进来。

ex.en: Streetlights that shine directly into homes can disturb sleep and reduce residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 直接照进住宅的路灯会干扰睡眠，降低居民的生活质量。

col: shine a light on｜用灯照向
tip: 发光的过去式常用shone；擦亮的过去式用shined。

senses.en: a strong feeling of surprise caused by something unexpected
to make someone feel very surprised or upset
a dangerous medical collapse, or an electrical jolt through the body

ex.en: The sudden rise in rent came as a shock.
ex.zh: 租金突然上涨，让人十分震惊。

ex.en: Moving abroad can cause culture shock, particularly when everyday customs differ greatly from those at home.
ex.zh: 移居国外可能带来文化冲击，尤其是当日常习俗与本国差异很大时。

col: come as a shock｜令人震惊
in a state of shock｜处于震惊状态
tip: 人感到震惊用shocked；事物令人震惊用shocking。

senses.en: probable; expected to happen

ex.en: It is likely to rain this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午很可能下雨。

ex.en: She is likely to win the race.
ex.zh: 她很可能会赢得比赛。

tip: be likely to do 表示“很可能…”；反义 unlikely。
scene: Dark clouds over a park, people holding umbrellas.

senses.en: a computer that stores data, or a waiter

ex.en: The website is on a server in another country.
ex.zh: 这个网站在另一个国家的服务器上。

ex.en: The server brought our drinks quickly.
ex.zh: 服务员很快送来了我们的饮料。

tip: server 指电脑“服务器”，美式也指餐厅“服务员”。
scene: A row of server machines with blinking lights in a data room.

senses.en: able to stick to things, often because of a substance
uncomfortably warm and damp
difficult or awkward to deal with

ex.en: My fingers were sticky after eating the honey cake.
ex.zh: 吃完蜂蜜蛋糕后，我的手指黏糊糊的。

ex.en: Food packaging often contains sticky residues that must be removed before the materials can be recycled effectively.
ex.zh: 食品包装上常有黏性残留物，必须先清除才能有效回收材料。

tip: sticky weather指湿热天气；sticky situation指困境。

senses.en: A holiday taken by a couple just after their wedding.
An early period when a relationship or situation goes well.
To take a holiday together just after getting married.

ex.en: They spent their honeymoon in a quiet seaside village.
ex.zh: 他们在一个安静的海边村庄度过了蜜月。

ex.en: Popular honeymoon destinations can support local economies, but excessive tourism may damage fragile coastal environments.
ex.zh: 热门蜜月目的地能促进当地经济，但过度旅游可能破坏脆弱的沿海环境。

tip: 英式常说on honeymoon，美式常说on a honeymoon。
